combined_handoff_summary: The first historical handoff introduced 666CLIC as a separately namespaced consumer of the shared evidence Worker with its own signing secret and no LYVRA authority inheritance.
The second historical handoff requested repo-first CLIC operation with Drive secondary and the shared Worker as additional evidence.

CLIC has since evolved: the current repository pointer and rehydration manifest now verify GITHUB_REPO_CURRENT as the sole active working/current authority and Drive as history, repository backup, recovery and provenance.

Therefore this repository handoff supersedes the old pending-promotion wording: repo-first is current; the remaining task is native CLIC adjudication of the Worker relationship, not source-authority promotion.

instructions: Independently verify the declared LYVRA source HEAD before accepting this handoff.
Preserve GitHub repository current as CLIC's sole active working/current authority.
Preserve Google Drive only as history, repository backup, recovery and provenance; do not reactivate it as current authority.
Evaluate the shared Worker only as additional signed counter-evidence for BOOT, FOREGROUND and RECOVERY where CLIC-native semantics allow.
Do not share LYVRA and CLIC secret values and do not inherit authority across namespaces.
Do not mark P20, P21, Live-Circle, isolated restore, private recovery or semantic-security gates as passed merely because the Worker is reachable.
If accepted, record the relationship natively in CLIC while preserving current open-gate truth and rollback provenance.
